text:
elaine.docs: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1287 — standardize SDK examples, fix /migration/v1 link, rename Python param model->model_id. Need 2 reviewers + merge today for release train. PTAL.
jamal: On it. I'm fine to review after lunch (~13:30 PT). Are there any contentious API wording changes?
elaine.docs: Main wording: change 'Redwood' -> 'Redwood Inference' in public-facing docs; prefer active instructions: 'Call the API' vs 'You can call'. Also enforce terminology: 'model variant' not 'model flavor'.
priyanka: I can review for tone + examples in ~30m. Quick heads-up: the Python snippet uses 'model' param in examples — we should update sample to use model_id and mention backwards-compatibility note.
mike_r: Docs preview CI failing on linters — code fence lang tag missing on one snippet. Error: 'fenced code block missing language' in /sdk/python/usage.md line 42. I'll drop the failing CI log: ```bash
Error: Fenced code block missing language: /sdk/python/usage.md:42
```
luis_infra: Preview built: https://deploy-preview-1287--redwood-docs.netlify.app — but it 404s until CI passes. Once fixed, add 'docs-lgtm' label and we can merge in the 16:00 UTC merge window.
elaine.docs: I've pushed a tiny fix — added ```python``` fence and updated param name in snippet. Also added a migration blurb: 'If your code used model, map to model_id until next major'.
jamal: Quick content nit: avoid 'we' in API reference. Example: change 'we return' -> 'the API returns'.
priyanka: Agree. Also prefer imperative voice for steps. I'll leave a couple inline suggestions.
docs-bot: automated: CI/tests: docs-preview failed (lint). Waiting for new commit.
mike_r: Re-run CI? @luis_infra can you trigger the docs-preview re-build once tests pass?
luis_infra: :thumbsup: I'll re-trigger after green. Also ensure two approvals — @jamal and @priyanka.
elaine.docs: Tagging reviewers now. Thanks all. Will merge once CI green and 2 approvals. If anything blocks, ping me in this thread.
priyanka: Approved after nits fixed. :white_check_mark:
jamal: Approved. :rocket:
docs-bot: automated: Preview ready: https://deploy-preview-1287--redwood-docs.netlify.app (build id xyz) — diff looks good, code fences fixed.
elaine.docs: Merging in 5m into main, will monitor post-merge preview. If any rollbacks needed, tag eng-oncall.
